[Guild Donation] Unlocks after joining a Guild at Character Lv. 15. Donate to earn Guild Tokens and construction materials like Steel, Kanstein Cells, and Mana Clusters. Up to 5 times per day, including 1 free attempt. Spending Dawnium ×70 for two additional attempts is highly recommended for progression.

[Guild Shop] Prioritize discounted items and Fantomon growth materials.
